name: What is the typical cost range for a bathroom addition?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for a bathroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a bathroom addition can vary significantly, ranging from $20,000 for a basic half-bath to over $70,000 for a luxurious master bathroom with high-end finishes and custom features. Key factors influencing cost include the size of the addition, choice of fixtures and materials, plumbing and electrical requirements, and the need for structural modifications. We provide a detailed estimate based on your specific design and material selections.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for a bathroom addition typically range from $20,000 to over $70,000, depending on size, materials, and complexity.
